messages:
erin (AE): Heads-up: AuroraPulse wants a POC. Blockers: SSO (SAML) integration, SCIM provisioning for ~45k users (Okta source), fine-grained RBAC mappings (nested groups), domain ownership verification across multiple domains, and a short Dedicated trial quote. They also attached our 60-question security questionnaire. Can we cover before Tue kickoff?

sam (Solutions Eng): I can take SAML + SCIM runbook. Need IdP metadata (XML), ACS URL, and confirmation Okta will be source of truth. SCIM notes to share: support PATCH for delta, POST /scim/v2/Bulk for bulk ops (chunk <=2500), async import for >5k, default rate limit 600/min/org.

jade (SE): For RBAC, ask them to supply a CSV (group_path,role_id,permissions) and sample user mapping. We support nested group paths. I'll include a sample CSV in the runbook.

mohit (Security): On questionnaire: we can share SOC2 Type II and redacted pen-test summary. For Dedicated trials in EU, infra sits in eu-west and we can provide a DPA excerpt. If PHI is in scope they need a signed BAA before data ingestion. Also: SCIM token minimal scope doc needed (provision:Users, update:Users, read:Groups).

erin (AE): Domain verification: they asked if DNS TXT, SAML entity verification, or file upload works. Which is fastest?

sam (Solutions Eng): DNS TXT is usually fastest for infra teams; SAML metadata verification works for IdP owners. File upload is slower and manual. Recommend DNS TXT and provide API webhook option for automated delegation flows.

jade (SE): Pricing: propose 2x-A10G equivalent Dedicated eval, 14 days, soft cap on tokens and a one-time enablement fee for bulk import/enablement (staging bucket + engineer). I'll draft quote.

erin (AE): Ok -- also ask them to confirm expected concurrency and peak token rate so we can size GPU config appropriately.

mohit (Security): Include rotation guidance: SCIM tokens must be rotateable, we log all provisioning actions to audit logs, and exports available via admin console. For delegated admins, limit scope (invite users, assign roles) and prevent access to KMS or raw tokens.

rachel (Legal): Quick note on wildcard domains: we do not accept wildcard TXT verification by default. Options: verify a delegated subdomain (verify.aurora.com) or per-subdomain TXT. Wildcard exceptions require legal sign-off + attestation. I'll prepare wording.

erin (AE): Action items: @sam produce one-page SAML+SCIM runbook + SCIM rate limits snippet; @jade sample RBAC CSV + draft Dedicated quote; @mohit security pack + SCIM token scope doc; @rachel legal wording for domain verification and BAA note. I'll assemble and send presales pack to AuroraPulse by EOD.

cal-bot: Created meeting "AuroraPulse POC Kickoff"  2025-09-09 15:00 UTC. Invitees: erin (AE), sam (Solutions Eng), jade (SE), mohit (Security), rachel (Legal). Link: https://cal.example/evt/AUR-POC

sam (Solutions Eng): Small runbook snippet to include in pack:
```
SAML: Provide IdP metadata XML + ACS URL
SCIM delta: PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} (use externalId)
Bulk: POST /scim/v2/Bulk (chunk <=2500), async >5k
Rate-Limit: 600/min per org, respect Retry-After on 429
CSV import: upload to staging bucket; scheduling 24-48h lead for large jobs
```

erin (AE): Thanks all. If Okta bulk or EU-only hosting is a blocker we'll escalate to contracts. Ping me immediately if anything changes. :thumbsup:
